pairing_note: The counted statement is the author's lemma environment at source lines 28470-28483 (label lemma-Rlim-gives-complete, canonical tag 09AU): for a Noetherian ring A, an ideal I and objects K_n over the quotients A over I^n with compatible transition maps whose reductions are isomorphisms, and with K_1 bounded above, the derived limit K is derived complete and the reduction of K modulo I^n is K_n. The proof environment at source lines 28485-28517 immediately follows it and is its own proof: derived completeness comes from the criterion on derived limits, and the second assertion is obtained by choosing bounded above complexes of free modules over each quotient and lifting the transition maps so that the reductions are isomorphisms of complexes, after which K is the limit of a bounded above complex of flat modules and the reductions can be computed termwise, the system stabilizing at the n-th term.
